title: Blue Muse|Rooftop + Sauna|10 Minutes to Broadway
description:
Welcome to The Blue Muse, a brand new, spacious Nashville retreat designed around music and experience. Enjoy the private rooftop and unwind in the sauna after a day in the city. Each room features curated, music inspired decor with QR codes to scan and play songs, telling a story of Nashville’s sound. A high quality stereo system sets the vibe for any moment. Just minutes from Broadway, this stay is as memorable as the city itself. Primary Guests must be 25+ to book!
